objects.name: ug_artists_indexed
ug_artists_unindexed
ug_index_artist_added
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ug_index_artist_added AFTER INSERT ON ug_index BEGIN
  INSERT INTO ug_artists(artist_key) SELECT new.artist_key
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ug_artists WHERE artist_key = new.artist_key);
END

objects.name: ug_index_artist_changed
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ug_index_artist_changed AFTER UPDATE OF artist_key ON ug_index
WHEN new.artist_key IS NOT old.artist_key BEGIN
  INSERT INTO ug_artists(artist_key) SELECT new.artist_key
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ug_artists WHERE artist_key = new.artist_key);
  DELETE FROM ug_artists WHERE artist_key = old.artist_key
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ug_index WHERE artist_key = old.artist_key);
END

objects.name: ug_index_artist_gone
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ug_index_artist_gone AFTER DELETE ON ug_index
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ug_index WHERE artist_key = old.artist_key) BEGIN
  DELETE FROM ug_artists WHERE artist_key = old.artist_key;
END

ug_index_fts_changed
ug_index_fts_gone
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ug_index_fts_gone AFTER DELETE ON ug_index BEGIN
  INSERT INTO ug_index_fts(ug_index_fts, rowid, artist_key, song_key)
  VALUES ('delete', old.tab_id, old.artist_key, old.song_key);
END

ug_keys_words
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ug_keys_words AFTER INSERT ON ug_keys BEGIN
  INSERT INTO ug_key_words(term) SELECT DISTINCT value FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid('["' || replace(new.key, '-', '","') || '"]')
  THEN '["' || replace(new.key, '-', '","') || '"]' ELSE '[]' END)
  WHERE value != '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ug_key_words WHERE term = value);
END
